activity_summary: At the window you said you had gone by the lane without meaning to, and that the upper shutter was up. You said that was twice, and that you would not go a third time. You said the sonnet did not need her in it. You did not say a name.

entities.name: the keyboard sonnet
entities.context: Mentioned in Written to a shutter

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: That is twice. I'll not go for a third.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: It's a sonnet. It doesn't need her in.
